name: Haligen Zero
source:
Washington is plagued by a series of unexplained disappearances. Mysterious Shadows abduct people in broad daylight, and no one seems capable of stopping them.

"Haligen 0" follows Chase Haligen, a researcher who investigates the phenomenon of the Shadows alongside his friend, the Professor. After a tragic incident changes his life forever, Chase sets out to uncover the truth, find answers, and seek justice.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4734790/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
华盛顿受到一系列不明原因失踪事件的困扰。神秘的阴影在光天化日之下绑架人们，似乎没有人能够阻止他们。

《哈利根0》讲述了蔡斯·哈利根 (Chase Haligen) 的故事，他是一名研究员，与他的朋友教授一起研究阴影现象。一场悲惨事件永远改变了他的生活后，蔡斯开始揭露真相、寻找答案并寻求正义。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4734790/]Steam[/url]]
